goal: Empirical vLLM runtime optimization of Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 at a 32,768-token context on 2x RTX 4090; inference only (weights, tokenizer, prompts, sampling and scoring unchanged)
model: work/derived/qwen3.5-0.8B-text-gold (Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B @ 2fc0636 text export, model.safetensors sha256 68194c7b...); MTP runs: work/derived/qwen3.5-0.8B-text-gold-mtp (code/bench/add_mtp_head.py); swap test also work/derived/qwen3.5-0.8B-text-p50c
environment: results/env/environment.json (vLLM 0.33.0, torch 2.14.0+cu130, lock verified; both GPUs tensor-unlocked)
harness: code/bench/vllm_bench.py (offline vllm.LLM, one engine per config per GPU), queue.py, run_one.sh, summarize.py, check_outputs.py, plots.py, weight_swap.py, run_swap.sh, run_stage_f.sh, gemm_probe.py
measurement: 1 discarded warm-up + 2-3 repeats per case; prefix cache reset before every repeat; startup timed separately; greedy ignore_eos for synthetic token-id workloads; Phase D pilot sampling (T=0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, n=4, seed 0) for C/P

stages.what: baseline both GPUs (A,B,C,D,E x3), exact pilot reproduction (P), cold-cache start

stages.jobs: configs/vllm_perf/stage1_screen.json (25 configs run; the 3 MTP configs were superseded by the reduced stage1b list to shorten wall time)

stages.what: combined finalists vs fresh baseline, D up to 64, x2
hold-out workload mixes not used for selection
in-place reload_weights Gold->p50c->Gold vs fresh p50c engine

execution_notes: Stage 1 originally ran full workloads per config (~10 min each); after operator feedback that the benchmark took too long, the queue was stopped after 25 configs and remaining/next stages used 2 repeats and fewer concurrency levels (dispersion CV <= 0.3% justified it)
A first stage-2 launch failed immediately (relative interpreter path in a background shell); relaunched with absolute paths; no results were affected

An early smoke run left an orphaned EngineCore holding GPU0 memory (os._exit without engine shutdown); fixed by explicit engine_core.shutdown() and per-job session reaping in run_one.sh before the campaign

outputs.compact: results/ (summary.json, cases.csv, startup.csv, output_equivalence.json, swap_*.swap.json, figures/, env/)
outputs.raw: evidence/20261103T-vllm-perf-32k/ (per-repeat jsonl rows, meta, editor texts, engine logs; gzip)
